law: Sex-specific Gaussian rank copula with deterministic feasibility repair
latent_correlation: For each supplied sex-specific marginal pair, use log(1 + r*CV_FEV1*CV_FVC) / sqrt(log(1 + CV_FEV1^2)*log(1 + CV_FVC^2)), clipped to [0,1]. This is a lognormal moment-matching approximation, not an exact finite-grid calibration.
rank_generation: Evaluate standard-normal midquantiles at ascending FEV1 ranks. Add independent Gaussian noise using the latent correlation, then assign ascending FVC values according to the resulting score ranks.
feasibility_repair: Process FEV1 rows in descending order. Assign the still-available feasible FVC index nearest the proposed index, breaking distance ties toward the lower index. Leave already feasible proposals unchanged.
transport_assumption: Use the reported healthy-source dependence as an explicit working assumption for both target strata; do not invent a numerical dependence adjustment for broader target health status.
